verdict.rationale: Convex lists file storage as a built-in feature ('file storage for large objects'), and it appears on the Free & Starter plans, so a first-party storage capability exists. The pack only gives one-line mentions, with no detail on how uploads or serving work, nothing on file-specific access rules, and nothing on CDN delivery. missing for 10: documented upload/serve flow, file-level access-rule enforcement, CDN-backed delivery, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can upload and serve user files with access rules and CDN-backed delivery

citations.quote: Convex also includes a scheduler for running background workflows, file storage for large objects, vector search, text search.
